name: IMPOSSIBLE Wall Hop Obby
desc:
Welcome to IMPOSSIBLE Wall Hop Obby! This game is a difficulty chart obby where the obstacles are primarily wall hops! Only 1% of players win! Can you beat the game without rage quitting?

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shiftlock (Shift, LT)
